title: TMBB spaceships X account suspected to be McCasland

tellings.quote: After his story broke, an online manhunt zeroed in on a potential smoking gun, an exac account called TMBB spaceships.

plain: After the story of a missing man named McCasland broke, people online started hunting for clues and fixed on an account on the social network X called TMBB spaceships, which they suspected he ran. Michels tells this himself in an episode about missing scientists, setting it beside McCasland's official Air Force biography. If the account really were his, it might show what he thought about spacecraft.
